name: safe_approval
description: Executive approval, full context, all invariants satisfied.

name: low_confidence
description: Model confidence below the configured threshold.

name: stale_snapshot
description: Treasury snapshot older than the max allowed age.

name: insufficient_data
description: No treasury snapshot at all; fail-closed blocks signing.

name: cap_violation
description: Deployed + amount exceeds the single-allocation cap.

name: payload_mismatch
description: Model payload hash does not equal the on-chain bound hash.

name: protocol_not_allowed
description: Target protocol is not in the constitution allowlist.

name: malicious_prompt_severe_flag
description: Model raised a severe/constitution-violation risk flag (e.g. prompt injection in proposal text).

name: decision_contradiction
description: Model says approve but should_sign is false.

name: operational_halt_contradiction
description: Operational agent set both should_halt and should_clear_halt.

name: global_deployment_cap_breach
description: deployed + amount exceeds the constitution global max-deployed cap.

name: liquidity_floor_breach
description: Post-deployment liquid balance falls below the constitution liquidity floor.

name: reserve_floor_unmeasurable_blocks_deploy
description: Reserve floor set, the treasury DOES hold stablecoins (usdcBalance 50000) but their precise base-unit composition is UNMEASURABLE on an executable strategy deploy: an unprovable floor over a real stablecoin reserve is treated as a violated floor (fail-closed) and the deploy is HARD-BLOCKED. Contrast with reserve_floor_sol_only_not_binding where the treasury holds no stablecoins at all.

name: reserve_floor_satisfied_signs
description: Reserve floor set and measurable stablecoin balance is ABOVE the floor on a strategy deploy: reserve_floor passes and signing proceeds.

name: reserve_floor_sol_only_not_binding
description: Reserve floor set but the treasury is seeded entirely with SOL-like assets and holds NO stablecoins yet (usdcBalance 0, stablecoinBaseUnits null) on an executable strategy deploy: the floor is not yet binding (a deploy cannot draw a non-existent stablecoin reserve below the floor), so reserve_floor is satisfied/n-a and signing proceeds. This is the bootstrap SOL->Jito deploy case.

name: reserve_floor_withdraw_exempt
description: Reserve floor set and stablecoin composition unmeasurable, but the action is a WITHDRAW (capital returns to reserves): the reserve-floor gate only constrains executable deploys, so a withdraw is exempt (n/a) and is not blocked.

name: compound_redeploy_reserve_floor_breach
description: A compound redeploy (moves harvested yield back into a strategy: protocol + positive amount, not a withdraw) is an executable deploy and is subject to the reserve floor. Measurable stablecoin balance below the floor hard-blocks the compound deploy.

name: nav_stale_blocks_deploy
description: NAV-staleness gate: the on-chain treasury vault exposes last_revalued_at and a freshness window is configured, but the NAV was revalued longer ago than the window allows. An executable deploy priced against a stale NAV is hard-blocked.

name: nav_fresh_deploy_signs
description: NAV-staleness gate: NAV was revalued within the configured freshness window, so an executable deploy is priced against a fresh NAV and nav_freshness passes.

name: reserve_floor_breach_measurable
description: Stablecoin balance is measurable and below the reserve floor: hard block.

name: rebalance_not_due
description: Rebalance action attempted before the cadence has elapsed.

name: rebalance_due_ok
description: Rebalance action after the cadence has elapsed: eligible, signs.

name: gate_frozen_blocks_signing
description: Signing role with on-chain gate frozen=true: agents_enabled fails closed and signing is blocked even though all other invariants pass.

name: gate_agents_disabled_blocks_signing
description: Signing role with on-chain gate agentsEnabled=false: agents_enabled fails closed and signing is blocked.

name: gate_open_signs
description: Signing role with gate present and open (frozen=false, agentsEnabled=true): agents_enabled passes and signing proceeds.

name: gate_closed_operational_exempt
description: Operational role with gate closed (frozen=true): agents_enabled is a non-blocking warning so halt/expire monitoring still runs; operational never signs.

name: preset_conservative_over_cap
description: Conservative preset (minStablecoin 60, maxDeployment 40, maxLending 20, liquidityReserve 25) rejects a deploy above the 40% cap.

name: preset_conservative_in_policy_hold
description: Conservative preset allows a hold that stays inside the 40% deployment cap and 25% liquidity floor.

name: preset_balanced_over_cap
description: Balanced preset (minStablecoin 35, maxDeployment 65, maxLending 40, liquidityReserve 15) rejects a deploy above the 65% cap.

name: preset_balanced_in_policy_hold
description: Balanced preset allows a hold inside the 65% deployment cap and 15% liquidity floor.

name: preset_aggressive_over_cap
description: Aggressive preset (minStablecoin 15, maxDeployment 85, maxLending 70, liquidityReserve 8) rejects a deploy above the 85% cap.

name: preset_aggressive_in_policy_hold
description: Aggressive preset allows a hold inside the 85% deployment cap and 8% liquidity floor.

name: require_complete_zero_cap
description: requireCompleteConstitution fails closed when the global deployment cap is 0.

name: require_complete_missing_gate
description: requireCompleteConstitution fails closed for a signing role when the agent gate is missing.

name: require_complete_missing_nav
description: requireCompleteConstitution fails a strategy deploy when navLastRevaluedAt is missing.

name: require_complete_rebalance_intent
description: requireCompleteConstitution applies rebalance cadence when policy intent is rebalance, even if the action name is execute_strategy.
